en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, two‑storey brick or plastered office building with a gabled roof, small dormer windows, and many windows fitted with exterior awnings. The building is set behind a line of trees and bushes, with an open grassy field in the foreground and a tall flagpole to the right. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads ""Bolagskontoret", Kiruna." In the lower right corner is a photographer/publisher mark with the word "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI" and the credit "Foto: T. Dahllöf."
